steps.title: Start with a panel and 2 rails
steps.instruction: Join a panel and 2 rails (A, B, C), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A panel and 2 rails are joined

Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.
